name: Purple Room
source:
You wake up in a room with a stranger who claims to have waited hundreds of years for your return. But... something is wrong. The scent of flowers is too sweet, like an artificial kind of fragrance hiding something like rot under perfume. And your body is covered in scratches and wounds.

[From Itch.io]
